$comment: SUN-1000 checkpoint 1B — single authoritative version/provenance source for security-release scanners. Every pnpm security:* script and CI job reads this file; no version is duplicated elsewhere. Binaries themselves are never committed (see .gitignore's .security-tools/ entry) — this file pins exact versions and, where upstream publishes them, per-asset SHA256 checksums, verified before any downloaded binary is ever executed.

semgrep.provenance: PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/semgrep/1.173.0/), installed into a dedicated, version-pinned virtualenv (.security-tools/semgrep-venv). PyPI's package index is served over TLS with per-file digests in its simple-index metadata (verified by pip itself); this is a real, exact version pin and integrity-verified-at-transport-and-index-level install, though not a full `pip --require-hashes` pin of Semgrep's entire transitive dependency tree (a scope simplification, recorded honestly in the checkpoint 1B report rather than silently claimed as strict).
